facts: Parties: Elstree Marine Ltd (Buyer), Calloway Media Ltd (Seller); the Company is Ivybridge Energy plc.
This Agreement is dated 9 February 2027; Closing is scheduled for 2 April 2027 (the 'Closing Date').
Section 15.1: this Agreement is governed by English law and the courts of England have exclusive jurisdiction.

Section 1.1: 'Material Adverse Change' means any event which has a material adverse effect on the business of the Company, excluding changes in general economic conditions, changes affecting the industry generally, and pandemics.
Section 4.5: if the Conditions are not satisfied by the date falling 150 days after the date of this Agreement (signed 9 February 2027), either party may terminate.
Section 9.7: the Buyer must notify any warranty claim within 30 days of becoming aware of it.
Clause 12: this escrow agreement is governed by the laws of the State of New York and disputes shall be referred to arbitration in New York.
Clause 5.2: a claim against the Escrow Amount must be notified within 45 days of the Buyer becoming aware of it.
Present: 2 directors (of 5). The meeting was quorate. RESOLVED to approve entry into the Share Purchase Agreement.
Article 11: the quorum for board meetings is three directors.
Regulatory counsel expects merger clearance by 23 July 2027.
